summary: iter312 regression: backend rock-solid, frontend Edit hydration BROKEN. (1) All 12 iter312 backend pytest cases pass (6 ai_review_dataloss + 6 draft_expiry). (2) `make regression-fast` = 147 passed / 3 skipped / 0 failed (122s). (3) D1 root-cause fix verified live: locked-* stub doc persists every seller field (location/city/region/country/postal_code/province/title/title_fr/condition/currency/buy_now_price) and admin approve preserves them byte-identical. (4) D2 backend PUT-edit-while-pending works; resubmit-for-review returns 200 with valid rescan outcome. (5) D3 draft-expiry sweep handles all age bands, all 5 collections, idempotency, scheduler job registration. (6) Frontend Seller Dashboard correctly renders the new Edit/Resubmit/Delete data-testids for a pending listing — the old 🔒 locked banner is GONE (locked_banner_count=0). (7) Edit button navigates to /edit-listing/{id} successfully. ❌ CRITICAL: form hydration FAILS — GET /api/listings/locked-* returns 500 because the Pydantic `Listing` response model requires `current_price` and `auction_end_date`, but the locked-* stub doc has neither. Title input renders empty. Console shows 500 and the seller sees a blank Create-Listing form instead of their pre-filled data — defeating the whole D2 edit-mode UX promise.

critical.issue: Returns 500 for locked-* docs because Listing response model requires current_price + auction_end_date, but request_manual_vehicle_review stub omits both. Breaks frontend Edit hydration. Pydantic error: 'current_price Field required' + 'auction_end_date Field required' for Listing model.

integration_issues.issue: Hydration fetch (axios.get /api/listings/{locked_id}) returns HTTP 500 due to backend Pydantic validation error, so formData stays at defaults. Title/category/location/city fields all render EMPTY when they should be pre-filled. Seller cannot self-correct flagged listings — they would have to re-type the entire form. This negates the entire D2 'Universal Drafts / edit-pending' feature.

action_items: FIX BACKEND (CRITICAL): Make GET /api/listings/{id} tolerate locked-* / pending_admin_review docs. Options: (a) drop the response_model on the public detail endpoint and return the raw dict (minus _id); (b) make current_price + auction_end_date Optional in the Listing pydantic model; (c) coerce defaults (current_price = starting_price or 0; auction_end_date = stub far-future ISO timestamp) before returning. Option (b) is the safest one-line fix and matches the rest of the model's Optional pattern.

ADD a regression test: GET /api/listings/{locked_id} must return 200 with the seller's title/location/city for a pending_admin_review doc. (Currently no test covers this — that's why the backend pytest suite is 100% green while the live UX is broken.)
ALIGN testid naming: review request specified 'listing-title-input' but CreateListingPage uses 'title-input'. Update one or the other so future tests don't drift.
AFTER backend fix: re-validate the full seller→edit→resubmit loop end-to-end on the live UI.

rca of the issue: RCA — D2 Edit hydration broken: GET /api/listings/{id} declares response_model=Listing in routes/listings.py (or wherever the endpoint lives). The Listing pydantic model has `current_price: float` and `auction_end_date: datetime` as REQUIRED fields. The locked-* stub created by routes/admin_ai_review.py::request_manual_vehicle_review omits both (it only stores starting_price + buy_now_price). When the frontend's edit-mode useEffect calls axios.get(`${API}/listings/${editListingId}`), FastAPI tries to serialize the doc through Listing(**doc), Pydantic validation fails with 'Field required' errors for both fields, and FastAPI converts that to a generic 500 internal_server_error. Repro: `curl -s $BASE/api/listings/locked-<any_id>` → 500. Mitigation (one-line fix): change the Listing model to `current_price: Optional[float] = None` and `auction_end_date: Optional[datetime] = None`. Alternative: drop response_model and return raw dict (already excluding _id). Either approach lets the seller's pre-filled data flow into the Edit form.
